answer: A payout is split thus 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The echo schedule is applied in fable and horizon shows each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1076 identities would post 1059 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
